title: Zenodo metadata adapter + DOI provenance
context: A self-serve archive acceptance channel: an adapter that maps a datasheet to Zenodo deposition metadata and records the version DOI as provenance. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Code is MIT-licensed; deposits metadata/documentation only, never the dataset itself.
objective: Build a Zenodo metadata adapter that emits Zenodo deposition metadata from a datasheet and records the published version DOI as provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Adapter maps the canonical metadata model to valid Zenodo deposition metadata (documentation only; never the dataset itself).
Records the published version DOI into the dataset's provenance/outcome artifact as the acceptance evidence.
Committed fixtures exercise the adapter in CI; code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green; DCO signed-off; no credentials committed.
